title: Paella Barcelona: Market Visit, Tapas, Sangria and Paella Class
description: This is a culinary experience you won't forget. It is an authentic, fun, informative, laid-back, social, and hands-on recreational cooking experience. You will have the opportunity to make new friends worldwide while participating in our lessons, which will teach you how to prepare traditional Spanish dishes Paella, tapas, and sangria.

reviews.usertext: My family (husband and two daughters 21,15) took this cooking class with Chef Gabriel. It was a great way to learn about the history of Paella and also how to cook it. We started at the market buying fresh seafood to preparing the dish and then sitting down to eat the delicious paella while enjoying sangria. Highly recommend taking this class with your family (even with your kids who don’t really love cooking).

The paella cooking class was excellent. Gabrielle was very friendly and inviting. First we walked to an amazing market to buy all the ingredients. Back at the kitchen he got everything prepared while the 3 couples enjoyed some sangria. Gabrielle was very good at involving everyone in the process of preparing our giant seafood paella. He explained the history of this delicious cuisine and explained every detail of its preparation. The final product was exquisite! I would highly recommend this cooking class. lol

Gabriel is a phenomenal instructor and he took his time to teach us the intricacies of cooking and preparing seafood paella. The seafood portion was interesting and those skills can be used outside of paella. It was a small intimate group setting of 8 people and unlimited sangria. He was very patient and made the class a fun learning experience.

This was my second time in Spain and this paella was the best I’ve had!

Gabriel was a wonderful teacher - from seafood selection and calamari cleaning, to saffron quality, pan size, and the history of the dish. The space was comfortable, the atmosphere inviting, and the sangria plentiful. 10/10 would recommend for anyone who enjoys cooking, learning, and eating!

This was an excellent three hour event, meeting the gorgeous Gabriel, visiting the market, preparing the food, cooking Paella, drinking Sangria, eating tapas and the paella, meeting other 'sous' chefs from the US and Canada. Gabriel is very engaging and the perfect host. He is supported by an efficient team of helpers too.

We had great fun cleaning the squid!!

I would thoroughly recommend this if you wish to immerse yourself in genuine Spanish culture, that isn't touristy and a rip off. A great experience!

I had the best paella cooking experience with Gab. When I arrived the class, I found out I was the only one who booked the class at the time, but Gab still took me in and gave me a full private lesson instead of canceling or scheduling me. The whole class was very well planed and Gab explained every detail to make sure I do the right thing. He also talked about the history of paella and answered my questions nicely. He also made great sangria for me to drink and a delicious cupcake for dessert. I am not good at cooking, but today with Gab, I made a delicious paella. Highly recommended if you are looking for a great paella cooking experience!

This was an awesome class. Gabriel was entertaining and very knowledgeable and after a trip to the market to buy the seafood, we learnt to make a divine seafood paella and drink lots of sangria. I would recommend this to everyone visiting Barcelona. Brilliant!!!

We had an amazing time at Paella Barcelona. Gabrielle is an excellent chef and teacher. We started with a trip to the local market, which was lively and colorful; we snapped plenty of cool pictures. The following tapas were delicious and the the sangria was great after a warm day.

Gabrielle taught us everything we needed to know to make the dish from top to bottom. Unlike other cooking classes I’ve been to, I feel like I can actually make paella when I get home! I’ve had bad and great paella, this was solidly in the “great” category.

The other guests were very fun and friendly. We shared plenty of stories over dinner. Gabrielle is also a great musician— ask him to play a song when you go, you won’t be disappointed.

An excellent fun day out. Something a little different to do and the finished product of seafood paella was fantastic. Gabriel was an excellent host and the rest of the staff were friendly.
Everyone was involved from adults through to children and Gabriel explained all stages of the paella making process, and a little of the history very well. Would highly recommend.

It was fun and very interactive. Was a little longer than expected and we were very ready to eat towards the end (a little over 4 hours) but the chef was wonderful and very informative and I’d definitely recommend the tour. We have a great time!

Chef Gabriel took our group on a visit to the Market where he purchased all the fresh fish for our paella. As well, he purchased chicken for one person who doesn't eat seafood. The market visit also allowed us a brief time to purchase any items we might want. Our cooking class was excellent as Chef Gabriel has a deep knowledge of Spanish culture as well as paella. The dish was accompanied by his homemade sangria which was excellent.

A very fun filled (and sangria filled!) evening. Short trip to boqueira market to buy the seafood for the paella and then back to kitchen for sangria and tapas while Chef Gabriel organized ingredients for groups to make paella. Lots of fun and information while while we were doing hands on cooking. He was a super host and we had a very memorable evening. Just delightful…would highly recommend it!

Making paella with Chef Gabriel was easily a highlight of our trip. He was so gracious and fun to learn from. Going to the market to pick out the seafood was a fantastic way to start out the experience. We learned what to look for and how to pick the freshest items. Raquel had delicious tapas ready and waiting upon our return. Making the paella was so fun and it turned out amazing. Gabriel ate with us and it felt like we were all just sharing a meal as friends. I will be recommending this to anyone I know who is heading to Barcelona.

I visited the GAB LAB with a group of friends to celebrate a birthday, and it was hands down the best experience we had in Barcelona. Chef Gabriel and the GAB LAB team thought of every detail to make the evening special for our group. We learned to make paella and sangria from scratch, and learned about the history from Chef Gabriel. I love to cook and was excited to learn some new techniques, but the activity was great for our whole group (even those who don’t cook). I’m excited to be walking away with some new cooking skills and wonderful memories from our experience at the GAB LAB! I think it was a perfect activity for our group of friends, but would also be fun for families or work events. Don’t miss it when in BCN!

The Paella making experience started with a quick trip to the market (which we visited in more depth after the class as we had never seen anything like it!) Our chef selected fresh ingredients and seafood for us. Once we had what we needed then we walked back to the little flat where we began preparing the dish by chopping and cleaning our purchases from the market. The only bummer for me was the Sangria - the worst I’ve had in all of Spain - but the chef kept us busy so it wasn’t as missed as I would have assumed it was. Once we chopped everything we began cooking and our chef was very educational. I hope to be able to replicate this again at home! It was my sons 21st birthday that day and he said he had a great time!

This was an amazing class! Gabriel was very informative. He was fun and explained all the steps very well. Going to the market to pick out the fresh seafood was an amazing tip (my husband and I loved the market so much we went back the next 2 days for breakfast!)

The class was almost 4 hours long - we had sangria and snacks for Aperitivo hour. Would 10/10 recommend!

This was a great experience. Definitely recommend if you like eating and/or cooking. Gabriel was a great host, knowledgeable and funny. Learned some useful tips about handling seafood and paella was delicious. There are also other treats.

Made a last minute booking and it did not disappoint. Gabriel truly cares about you having a great time! He had a crazy overbooked day and accommodated an additional group but stayed cheerful for our last class. I was in a small group of three. It was so much fun to learn to make this Spanish dish while drinking sangria and eating nibbles of food before the main course! Keep in mind if you are going over the weekend or holiday, the market is closed!

We found out about this from a waiter at a cafe near our hotel. We quickly booked for our last night in Barcelona. It was a great experience. Gabriel was great! The people in the class with us were fun. This is a definite must do in Barcelona to take a break from crowds and sightseeing!

Simply unforgettable! Loved the vibe of the host and his wife, as well as the food and the general ambience.

Before the cooking lesson we went to a nearby market to get the ingredients. That bit was very interesting for us.

The location was quite convenient too since it was close to our accommodation.

100% will repeat during our next trip to BCN!

Gabriel graciously adjusted our paella to our food preferences. His enthusiasm for his passion made the experience incredibly fun and informative! The paella and sangria were excellent and the market visit memorable. We are in our 70s and highly recommend it to our generation as well.

We were a group of friends going to the cooking class. It was a great experience, we had a lot if fun, met new people and learned how to make the best paella ever!! The preparation was made under the chef’s instructions. During small pauses we were served nice tapas and sangeria. Can highly recommend this cooking class to everyone going to Barcelona.

Exceeded my expectations! The class was amazing, from going to the markets, learning how to prepare seafood and making the paella. The hosts were lovely and the environment was so welcoming and homely. One of our best nights in Barcelona and highly recommend!

Gabriel was a wonderful chef and teacher. Our class was only three of us and that was perfect. The other two were a couple my age. Or a bit younger. I love going to the market and learning about how to buy seafood. Also, I had never made paella before and I learned a whole bunch! He was a great teacher! I would recommend this class to anyone and everyone!

It was a great, hands on experience; very informative; lots of good tips.
The chef communicated well; interesting stories about history of paella.
In the end, we all got to help make it, step by step, then we ate it.
Best paella ever.

We also got to try really really good sangria.
A must.

This paella course was amazing!!! Chef Gabriel also made the experience so fun. We got the freshest seafood from the nearby market and we not only learned how to make the best Paella, we also learned the traditions and the history of it too. We also learned how to prep prawns and calamari for the most tasteful paella. It was an amazing experience. My 14yrs old son also enjoyed very much. Highly recommend.

Gabriel was extremely passionate about cooking and history of paella. We were able to go to the big market and pick out all ingredients. Sangria was served as well as a cheese and meat platter. It was a lot of fun learning about Spain’s most popular dish. I highly recommend this class for anyone traveling to Barcelona. The paella was the best we had.

This was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona. We thoroughly enjoyed every moment we spent with Gabriel. He taught us every detail of making a fabulous paella and the class was a lot of fun. Excellent teacher, and according to others in our class, their best paella making experience in Barcelona after trying several different ones. Highly recommend!

I had such a wonderful experience at the paella cooking class. Gabrielle made it so interesting learning about the difference fish and how to cook paella properly. At the start we we’re welcomed with tapas and sangria. Raquel was amazing too serving us and helping with the class. We then got our aprons on and started the class which was so much fun. It’s a great way to make friends, learn about the Spanish culture and enjoy paella and sangria.

I really recommend this and want to bring my friends when they are next in town!!

What an amazing experience, Gabriel explained things in a fun and interactive way. We bought the ingredients from the local market, learned how to clean the prawns, squid. He gave us little tips from how to chop the tomatoes and why. Gabriel is definitely a pro. We had some sangria and went home with all of the recipes as well as making new friends 🤗. Thanks again Gabriel for introducing me to Spanish cuisine which I plan to explore more in London 🙌

This was a real hands-on cooking experience.....from the visit to the marketplace to choose the seafood to the prep of said seafood! The only thing we didn't do was the clean up! Gabriel was very informative and made sure we understood what we were doing and why!

It was a whole evening which started with a walk to the market.....and then lots of food and sangria.

An absolutely wonderful experience. Highly recommended. Hosts were so sweet and even ran into them the next day on the street and chatted. Very informative, but really just a fun time. Felt like a local heading up to the market to buy some fresh seafood. Will be back to do it again!!

We had a great experience going to GAB LAB this summer, it was one of those opportunities when you get more than you expect for. I've never had the chance to not only taste a genuine paella but to learn a lot about the cooking process as well. Also, you find yourself together with great people from different countries and spend amusing moments with them. You share a participatory activity with people you meet for the first time (which is a great way to meet people!) or you can have a unique moment with your friends or family.
You get to feel very comfortable with such kind hosts as Gabriel and Raquel. They are very good explaining the details and the magic of this spanish plate.
A paella masterclass with everybody taking part of the cooking while you have some tapas and a few drinks of sangria. Learning, eating well and having fun, what more can you ask for? I will definitively come back soon.

I did two things for the first time in my life: taking a cooking class and cooking paella. And both things were unforgettable!

I can't be more than happy I went to Gastronomic Arts Barcelona and I would definitely recommend this experience to anyone who wants to try something new or just improve their cooking skills.

Great chef with a lot of experience and good skills in explaining each step so it's easy to follow even if you are a beginner in cooking like me.
Wonderful experience! Learned a lot, laughed a lot. Would highly recommend. Experience was as described
Great fun! We dived into one of Spains traditional plates! Great host! Excellent atmosphere! Anyone that likes food can join.
Gabriel is so patient and funny, great chef! Loved the experience and would recommend highly. Great chance to meet other travellers too

This was certainly the highlight of our trip to Barcelona! Our chef instructor, Gabriel, was outstanding and has a great sense of humor. The paella was by far the best we tasted in Barcelona. You must take this class!!!
It was a very good and pleasant experience. We had a good evening with great food, wine and nice company with 8 other people from all over world

Great family experience. We really enjoyed the visit to the market, cooking with fresh ingredients while sipping on some sangria. The paella was delicious and we all enjoyed our time with chef Gabriel.
Amazing local experience! The chef was very knowledgeable and friendly, I would 100% recommend to anyone looking for a genuine cooking experience in a relaxed and fun environment!!

We really enjoyed the class, definitely one of my Barcelona highlights! We loved every part of the cass—the market tour, making the paella, and the sangria. The chef was very knowledgeable and the food was so fresh. Definitely recommend!
What a fun and delicious evening!!! We learned so much about paella and got great cooking tips!!! If you want to learn how to make paella… this is the place!!

This was an amazing experience! Gabriel is a great chef and the entire process is very inclusive. You learn history, you go to the market, shop for fresh ingredients and have lots of fun cooking the paella. The complimentary tapas and sangria are delightful. Recommend this experience 100%.
A relaxed few hours of paella making and sangria drinking. Interesting, interactive and informative enjoyed by myself, my wife and 17 year old son.
Amazing class! So fun and this was the best paella I have eaten in Spain! Chef explained the history and ingredients so well. I recommend this class to everyone! Thank you, Chef!

I loved that we went with Chef Gabriel to the market to select the seafood and really enjoyed learning how to properly prepare the squid, prawns, and mussels. It was so much fun, DELICIOUS, and I really feel like I learned some kitchen tricks I'll be using forever.

Amazing class and really good experience to do with a group!
The staff were friendly and knowledgeable.
100% would do this again!
So much fun! I loved it! Lots of laughs and good times! The sangria was good and our paella came out delicious! Would definitely take this class again!

This cooking class was such a great experience. It was the perfect combination of hands on and being provided the opportunity to observe the process of making Paella. Gabriel is such a nice person and excellent instructor. You should definitely add this to your Barcelona itinerary 👍 PS the Paella was outstanding!

The Chef Gabriel has great local knowledge and cooking skills.

Really enjoyed our visit and making the Paella (and eating it). Throughly recommend to anyone interested!

Great paella class near the Rambla market. Our chef was patient and thorough in explaining the paella process including explaining about pans and other aspects to really make a traditional paella. Working in small group( limited to 12) was great. We only had two groups of 4( our friend group all worked together). Meeting the others from other countries and sharing paella, tapas and sangria was very delightful. All around great experience! Enjoy!
Awesome experience- lovely way to change up your evening and cook your supper instead of going out. The space is really superb and the sangria keeps flowing!
We celebrated a friend's birthday at the GabLab and had a wonderful time learning how to make paella and sangria. Highly recommend!

We came to Barcelona for our honeymoon and WOW! This is experience is an absolute MUST!! We had the best time making paella with Gabriel! We also brought along my in laws! It’s absolutely family friendly!

This was THE BEST part of my recent trip to Barcelona! The market trip wasn't just any market. It was picking up fresh food at La Boqueria including fresh vegetables to accommodate vegetarians! Gabriel made this cooking adventure such a memorable experience - one that I have already shared with some of my kids! Definitely an incredible memory! Thanks Gabriel!!
Amazing experience. Highly recommend to anyone who enjoys good food, good wine and good company. If I could give 10 out of 10, I would.

I can not recommend this class enough! It met my expectations and more, we go to go to a market to get fresh ingredients, learnt how to make paella, and got to eat plenty of delicious Paella! Bonus were given lots of Sangria and Chef Gabrielle even gave us a tip on how to make Sangria. I wasn’t sure what to expect going to a cooking class on my own, but my class mates were such a friendly bunch too :)

What an amazing night! Making Paella start to finish with Chef Gabriel was a highlight of our trip to Barcelona! He took us to the local market to shop for fresh seafood and ingredients, and brought us back to the kitchen for an interactive cooking class to prepare a beautiful and delicious paella for the group! With plenty of Sangria and snacks while we worked, our group had an absolutely wonderful evening together as friends. We were even able to arrange a beautiful birthday cake for our friend via their in house baker! The entire evening was very special, and will definitely be an experience we will never forget!

Amazing experience! My friend and I had the most fantastic time with Chef Gabriel learning how to cook Paella. The trip to the market, the tapas, sangria, dessert and the Paella were all so good! Highly recommend this to anyone visiting Barcelona.

Had a great time with chef and other guests. For a nice treat chef played the guitar and sang after our meal.
P. S. Haven’t received recipe yet.
This is THE cooking class if you prefer smaller, more intimate experience. Close to the market and nice open space provided an ideal setting to learn about Spain and paella.

This was a real treat and I highly recommend Gabriel's class for anyone who wants to learn more about cooking and Barcelona (or just wants to have fun, eat some amazing fresh paella and drink some sangria). Gabriel was a pleasure! Don't sleep on this experience!

This class was so much fun! And I will definitely be using the recipes again! Gabriel and the team were very welcoming, learning how to choose seafood at the market and the cooking itself was good fun, and the food and sangria were delicious! An excellent evening out in Barcelona!

Absolutely, amazing!!!! The best activity we had in Barcelona!!!!! Gabriel was extremely knowledgeable and entertaining! Had the entire group of 8 engaged during the entire class. At the end, ask Gabriel to play the harmonica "you won't regret it!" It was amazing and yes the Sangria was darn near bottomless!

Thank you Gabriel for the cooking lessons, the friends we made and the memories!

Easy to find location off La Rambla and great experience getting to learn about Paella over Sangria and appetizers. The cooking was fun, and again instructional, and tasted even better! Getting to experience the market to buy the fresh seafood was one of the highlights. The GABLAB is just getting started so there is a lot of attention given to each student and (currently) the classes are intimate not overwhelming. Would absolutely recommend!

What a wonderful experience! We made two different kinds of Paella, drank Sangria, had wonderful food, and wonderful company! Gabriel and his wife were wonderful hosts.
Would absolutely recommend to all that visit Barcelona.

We were fortunate to be the only ones in the class that day and got a little private classs. We started out at the market to pick out the seafood. Our chef showed us around and gave some info about the area. Then we headed back to the studio to learn about the history of paella and prepped all our food. They had apps and sangria to start. It was a really fun class. Would recommend.

It was a delicious and entertaining experience, the opportunity to learn more about Mediterranean cuisine, the paella was spectacular. The kindness and willingness of the hosts made this experience unforgettable and 100% recommendable.
It was a very nice experience, the staff was incredibly friendly and the place beautiful. Very recommended!!
In gablab we have spent a wonderful summer afternoon. me and my friends, we cooked and ate our own paella. I recommend you visit this original site in Barcelona, Spain. Chef Gabriel is very funny.

It was an excellent opportunity to discover Mediterranean cuisine and learn how to cook a real paella. The result was impressive, the best paella I ate in Barcelona. A very pleasant atmosphere and a delicious and refreshing sangria.

Learned to make delicious paella and sangria with old and new friends. The chef was great and taught us lot on the different types of paella. The 4 hours flew by with tasty tapas and sangria to accompany.
